name: Denver
lede: Mile-high disc golf where the foothills meet the plains — from the pine corridors of Beaver Ranch to the most-played course in the country. We're publishing the metro's best first.
introParagraphs: Denver disc golf runs on altitude and attitude. The metro's crown jewel is Beaver Ranch in the foothills above Conifer — a mountain course with three tee sets that turns the same 21 holes into a friendly loop or a 7,500-foot monster. Closer to town, Bird's Nest is one of the most-played courses in the United States, and Fehringer Ranch offers the city's best practice area with the foothills as a backdrop.

The thin air is real — discs fly farther here, which makes the big holes slightly kinder and the short holes sneakier. The Dragon Disc Golf Club runs Wednesday tags and weekend doubles, and the community is one of the friendliest in the West. Winter play is year-round on the lower-elevation courses, though snow shovels are standard equipment from November through March.

New to the area? Start at Fehringer Ranch, then graduate to the wooded tests once your lines are dialed. For gear, Bad Habit Disc Golf & Collectibles in Denver is the local shop, and Play It Again Sports carries new and used discs.

faqs.question: How many disc golf courses are in the Denver metro?
faqs.answer: There are 57 courses across the Denver metro, mapped and live on FindFrolf, with more added every week.

faqs.question: What's the best disc golf course in Denver?
faqs.answer: By player rating, Beaver Ranch is the metro's most-loved course — a pay-to-play mountain course with three tee sets and 21 holes. Bird's Nest in Arvada is the most-played course in the country if you want the full community experience.

faqs.question: Are Denver's disc golf courses free?
faqs.answer: Most are. 48 of the 57 mapped courses are free to play, and 9 are pay-to-play. Check each course page for its current green fee.

faqs.question: What's the best beginner course in Denver?
faqs.answer: Fehringer Ranch is one of the friendliest published courses — open fairways, the city's best practice area, and views of the foothills to make the walk worth it.

faqs.question: Where can I buy disc golf gear in Denver?
faqs.answer: Bad Habit Disc Golf & Collectibles in Denver is the dedicated pro shop. Play It Again Sports in Centennial carries new and used discs and starter sets.
